title: Accepting block condition
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x,\beta$ be Boolean lists, and let $s,L\in\mathbb{N}$. The accepting block condition holds when the pair encoding of $x$ with the pair encoding of the first $L$ entries of $\beta$ and the binary expansion of $s$ belongs to the acceptance language of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
caveat: The payload does not define the pair encoding, the acceptance language, or the machine convention for its binary expansion.
